preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 1_000_000 and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 1_000_000 and int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input graph has n vertices (1 ≤ n ≤ 1,000,000) and m edges (1 ≤ m ≤ 1,000,000), where each edge is a directed pair (a_i, b_i) with distinct endpoints (a_i ≠ b_i).
The input consists of exactly m + 1 lines: the first line contains n and m, and the next m lines contain the edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= n for v in selected_vertices)
postconditions.description: All selected vertices are valid vertex indices in the graph (1 ≤ v ≤ n).

postconditions.expression: len(selected_vertices) == k and all(v1 != v2 for v1, v2 in zip(selected_vertices, selected_vertices[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output starts with an integer k (number of selected vertices), followed by k distinct vertex indices.

postconditions.expression: all(not any((x, y) in edges or (y, x) in edges for x in selected_vertices for y in selected_vertices if x != y))
postconditions.description: No two vertices in the selected set Q are connected by a directed edge in either direction (no edge (x, y) or (y, x) exists for any x, y ∈ Q).

postconditions.expression: all(any((z == x) or (x, z) in edges and (z, y) in edges for x in selected_vertices for y in unselected_vertices for z in range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: For every vertex y not in Q, there exists at least one vertex x in Q such that y is reachable from x in at most two moves (direct edge (x, y) or a path x → z → y).
